source_inspection.continuation_disposition: Historical vocabulary establishes continuity/candidate labels only. It does not register terminal special-operation semantics.

move candidate/admission/selection contract over already-lawful V2 inputs
excludes: semantic meaning or activation of any unregistered recovered move label

noncollapse_law: ACTOR_ACCESSIBLE_TRUTH != V2_SALIENCE != V2_EXPRESSION_REGISTER != V2_RESPONSE_MOVE != RENDERED_EXPRESSION != CAUSAL_OCCURRENCE

base_operations.semantic_scope: Address one or more already-lawful expression targets as ordinary turn-level presentation without implying completeness or any special uncertainty, boundary, relationship, topic-shift, silence, challenge, correction, delay, or exit semantics.

registration_schema.registration_gate: A special operation becomes canonical only after a separately accepted authority owns both its distinct semantic scope and exact activation/constraint conditions. CAN-018 validates registration shape and selection compatibility but does not invent the operation.

canonical_exception.label: ENGAGE_SELECTIVE
canonical_exception.basis: Minimum positive ordinary-expression operation independently required by V2 expression planning when at least one lawful target exists and no special operation is required.

recovered_vocabulary_disposition.law: Recovered labels are candidate/compatibility vocabulary only. Historical prose, intuitive gloss, string identity, or prior executable use does not register terminal semantics or activation.

downstream_ownership_examples.MUST-022: may later register uncertainty-specific response operations only after acceptance
downstream_ownership_examples.MUST-023: may later register boundary/face-risk/effort/attention-constrained response operations only after acceptance
downstream_ownership_examples.CAN-019: may later register relationship-specific response operations only after acceptance

why_minimum_sufficient: V2-P5 requires a positive ordinary response-planning operation for the common case where lawful expression material exists.
The operation says only that some already-lawful targets may be addressed; it adds no special discourse act, psychology, uncertainty posture, boundary state, relationship posture, or causal meaning.
Without one positive base operation, ordinary lawful expression would be semantically starved even when no downstream special-operation authority is relevant.
base_operation_justification.not_legacy_default_inheritance: Historical engage_selective usage is continuity evidence only. Canonical status follows from the bounded V2 expression-planner need plus this exact positive rule; missing data never selects it.

special_operation_registration_law.string_match_behavior: Recovered/unregistered label string match has zero activation force.
special_operation_registration_law.compatibility_alias_behavior: Aliases may be retained for migration/audit only and cannot select or register an operation.

selector_input_precondition_law.hard_ceiling: ADP-017 ActorAccessibleRenderEnvelope or equivalent; selector may narrow/omit only
required: applicable accepted constraint receipts or explicit NOT_APPLICABLE
selector_input_precondition_law.base_rule: If at least one lawful expression target exists, all required constraint domains are satisfied or NOT_APPLICABLE, no separately accepted authority requires a special operation, and no accepted constraint forbids ordinary engagement, CAN018_BASE_ENGAGE_RULE@1.0.0 selects ENGAGE_SELECTIVE.
selector_input_precondition_law.special_move_rule: Only currently registered special operations are eligible. Unregistered recovered labels are not candidates. A requested special semantic with missing owning authority returns DEFERRED_REQUIRED_AUTHORITY rather than coercing ENGAGE_SELECTIVE into that special meaning.
selector_input_precondition_law.tie_rule: If two or more registered non-equivalent operations remain and no accepted precedence orders them, DEFERRED_AMBIGUOUS_NON_EQUIVALENT_MOVES; no lexical/list/random/LLM/score winner.

no_lawful_move_behavior: Zero lawful operation candidates after all gates -> VALID_EMPTY_NO_LAWFUL_MOVE, unless required independent authority/input/integrity is missing. No arbitrary fallback. Historical SILENCE is not a canonical operation in v1 and cannot be substituted for valid-empty.

keyword_numeric_default_disposition.keyword_topic: _POLITICAL_STRUCTURAL_KEYWORDS, _DISMISSIVE_PATTERNS, deep-memory keyword paths and topic labels are rejected as semantic authority. They may at most be nonauthoritative retrieval hints behind separately lawful candidate gates.
keyword_numeric_default_disposition.numeric: Quarantine AttentionBudget 0..100/default 50; 25/50/75 thresholds; sentence caps 2/4/6/8/12; tension/demand thresholds .5/.6/.75; any move score/weight. Future quantities require exact independent authority.
keyword_numeric_default_disposition.defaults: Reject prompt/get fallback engage_selective, brief_or_deflect, default 50/moderate/6, and filler question/decline/exit/silence.
keyword_numeric_default_disposition.render_rng: MUST-025 render RNG may vary wording after operation selection; it cannot select or register semantic operations.

noncausal_boundary.PRESENTATION_NONCAUSAL: Move/plan/render may display or persist as V2/session/audit only; no V3 mutation.
noncausal_boundary.IN_WORLD_CAUSAL: Rendered artifact remains CANDIDATE_NONCAUSAL_PENDING_V3_ADMISSION. Exact MUST-019 V3 admission of exact artifact/hash is required before it becomes something actor actually said/did. Move decision itself is never the admitted event; rerenders require new admission.

forbidden_entropy: V2 render RNG for move choice
replay_provenance.render_link: Later render request/receipt references exact move-decision hash.
